by: the coordinator of the rules audit, under the owner's approval of the audit's T-M7 of 2026-11-04
quote: Expected moves are fine, since R2 changes lines on purpose, but a failure of any other kind needs fixing. Make the check pass in whatever way the repo accepts for intended moves.
on: T-M7 of the rules audit (pull request 586): a word is hyphenated only where its line cannot be set within its word spaces' own stretch, half their natural width (TeX's \pretolerance pass)
scope: the rules gate's model tier on the CI runner at 8c860986 against the merge base 59d8d9e5: fr full size 24.0 % to 23.7 %, from the one output 1706.03762v7-fr (per output: 1 regression); every other measure of the 32 outputs unchanged or better, 8 pages of de and es moved by their line counts. On the lane's macOS runs of the same pack fr full size does not move
why: TeX hyphenates no word of a paragraph whose lines its spaces can set within their own stretch; the breaker hyphenated a word wherever a head of it fit, 29 % of the pack's Latin lines. A line that now keeps its word whole can leave its paragraph a line longer, and a unit is then set a size step under full size to keep its lines: the cost of the hyphens no longer drawn (3,763 hyphenated lines to 3,553 on the pack), not a defect of the page's format
